Name: ZYNU's High-Res Portraits
Author: zynushi
Description:
[u]How To Install (CP Version)[/u]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Scale Up 2
2. Open the SMAPI installer and click the right install file for your device
3. Move the Content Patcher unzipped folder to Steam -> Common -> Stardew Valley -> Mods
4. Move the Scale Up 2 unzipped folder to Steam -> Common -> Stardew Valley -> Mods
5. Download CP - ZYNU's High-Res Portraits, and move the unzipped folder to Steam -> Common -> Stardew Valley -> Mods
6. Launch the game using SMAPI (Steam -> Common -> Stardew Valley -> StardewModdingAPI)
7. Enjoy!

[u]How To Install (Portraiture Version)[/u]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI and Portraiture
2. Open the SMAPI installer and click the right install file for your device
3. Move the Portraiture unzipped folder to Steam -> Common -> Stardew Valley -> Mods
4. Download ZYNU's High-Res Portraits, and move the unzipped folder to Steam -> Common -> Stardew Valley -> Mods -> Portraiture -> Portraits
5. Launch the game using SMAPI (Steam -> Common -> Stardew Valley -> StardewModdingAPI)
6. Press P during dialogue to change portraits
7. Enjoy!

This mod is currently incompatible with PyTK, so you have to install Scale Up 2 as an alternative. 

Also, if you have SVE installed, do not download the CP version of my portrait mod because the Gunther/Marlon/Morris/Sandy/Wizard portraits don't work. (I have plans to do SVE/RGS portraits later in the future when I have more time). 

Other CP portrait mods (like Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic), also do not work with the CP version of my portrait mod. 

[u]Copyright:[/u]
This mod is for personal use only, which means you may only use it to change portraits in Stardew Valley. It is prohibited to modify, distribute, or use the portraits/mod for commercial purposes/AI training or editing.
